# dayloop v0.12.0-rc10 — P5R visual flow polish

This prerelease refines the P5R calendar and answer presentation, replaces the Day Complete artwork, and smooths the handoff from game selection into the tracker.

## What changed since rc9

- Enlarged the Calendar's `TODAY` marker and expanded its cutout background to fit the heavier label.
- Removed the redundant middle `Class question` label when the kind chip already says the same thing.
- Replaced the Day Complete graphic with the newly supplied artwork.
- Fits the entire new graphic at the top-right of the Day Complete splash so Joker remains recognizable and fully visible.
- Waits for the selected game pack to finish loading before leaving the picker.
- Adds a gentle fade and short upward settle from the game picker into Today, preventing partially loaded theme elements from popping into place.

## What to check

- Confirm the enlarged `TODAY` marker remains legible and contained by its red cutout.
- Confirm Class-question rows show only one `Class question` label and keep their date aligned right.
- Tap END DAY and confirm the replacement graphic is visible at the top-right with all of Joker in frame.
- Select each game from the picker and confirm its Today screen, background, and navigation chrome arrive together without flashing or snapping.
- Confirm Settings reports `Dayloop v0.12.0-rc10`.

## Candidate APK notes

- This APK is **not production-signed**. It uses Android's standard debug signing key for hands-on testing.
- Its application id is `com.shadowmonarchbooks.dayloop.candidate`, so it can be installed alongside the production Dayloop app.
- Version: `0.12.0-rc10` (`versionCode 23`).
